name: MMBench-Video
intro: MMBench-Video是一个用于严格评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）视频理解能力的定量基准。该基准包含来自YouTube的长视频和自由形式的问题，更贴近实际应用场景，旨在严谨评估模型的视频理解水平。所有问题均由人工根据精心构建的能力分类法进行标注。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, SenseTime Research, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 长视频理解, 时序推理, GPT-4评审
eval_feature_en: Long video understanding, Temporal reasoning, GPT-4 judging
intro_en: MMBench-Video is a quantitative benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the video understanding capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). It includes long videos from YouTube and open-ended questions, reflecting real-world scenarios, and aims to provide a thorough assessment of models' video comprehension. All questions are manually annotated based on a carefully constructed taxonomy of abilities.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect long-form videos from YouTube and other web sources"] --> B["Filter and package 609 videos covering broad real-world topics"]
    B --> C["Design an ability taxonomy for holistic video understanding and temporal reasoning"]
    C --> D["Ask volunteers to craft original high-quality questions for each video"]
    D --> E["Use free-form questions rather than simple multiple-choice shortcuts"]
    E --> F["Employ a GPT-4-based evaluation paradigm for model answers"]
    F --> G["Evaluate proprietary and open-source LVLMs and Video-LLMs"]
    G --> H["Report video understanding scores over 1,998 QA pairs"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从YouTube和其他网页来源收集长视频"] --> B["筛选并打包609个覆盖真实世界主题的视频"]
    B --> C["设计面向整体视频理解和时序推理的能力体系"]

    D --> E["使用自由形式问题而不是简单多选捷径"]
    E --> F["采用基于GPT-4的范式评审模型答案"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.14515, the NeurIPS dataset paper, and the MMBench-Video project page. The benchmark selects roughly 609 long-form web/YouTube videos, creates 1,998 human-authored free-form QA pairs using a carefully constructed video ability taxonomy, targets temporal and holistic video understanding, uses a GPT-4-based evaluator, and reports LVLM/Video-LLM performance.
